summary: Official application page is live and the Flagship program has rolling application deadlines, but no current future deadline or next cohort start date is published; the only posted next class date, January 22, 2026, is now past.

proposed_event.name: Alchemist Accelerator Flagship Program
proposed_event.description: Six-month accelerator for AI-SaaS and deeptech startups monetizing from enterprises.

dates.date_range_text: Rolling application deadlines; each class runs six months. Latest posted class began January 22, 2026, which is past as of 2026-06-09.

sources.title: Alchemist Program Application
sources.supports: Official application page is live and embeds the Alchemist application form.

sources.title: Flagship Program
sources.supports: Official page states the Flagship program begins January 22, 2026, runs six months, supports participation from anywhere, includes San Francisco in-person events and co-working, and has rolling application deadlines.

sources.title: Alchemist Home
sources.supports: Official home page describes Alchemist as a six-month journey with coaching, investor access, commercialization support, mentoring, fundraising support, credits and discounts, and an average $30,000 net investment proceeds after tuition offset.

notes: Current exact application deadline is not published in crawlable official content despite the FAQ saying deadlines are listed on the home page.
The January 22, 2026 class start is stale relative to today, so program_start and program_end are left null.
Used allowed taxonomy sectors ai, saas, and deeptech instead of the existing non-allowed enterprise sector.
